## Pull request overview

This pull request migrates CRM documentation from `examples/app-crm/docs` to `content/docs/developer` as a structured developer guide section. The migration converts all documentation files to `.mdx` format with fumadocs frontmatter, removes numerical prefixes from filenames (e.g., `01-data-modeling.md` → `data-modeling.mdx`), and establishes a navigation structure through `meta.json` files.

**Changes:**
- Migrated 6 documentation files (README, data modeling, business logic, security, AI capabilities, and standards) to the developer guide section
- Added navigation metadata through `meta.json` files defining page order
- Updated internal links to use extension-less paths without numerical prefixes
- Deleted empty contracts meta.json file

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/meta.json | Added developer section to root documentation navigation |
| content/docs/developer/meta.json | Defined page order for developer guide (index, data-modeling, business-logic, security, ai-capabilities, standards) |
| content/docs/developer/index.mdx | CRM application overview and quick start guide |
| content/docs/developer/data-modeling.mdx | Object schema design, field types, relationships, and validation rules |
| content/docs/developer/business-logic.mdx | Validation rules, workflow rules, triggers, approval processes, and formula logic |
| content/docs/developer/security.mdx | Security model guide covering profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, and sharing rules |
| content/docs/developer/ai-capabilities.mdx | AI agents, RAG pipelines, natural language queries, and predictive analytics |
| content/docs/developer/standards.mdx | Development standards and best practices for ObjectStack applications |
| content/docs/references/contracts/meta.json | Deleted empty contracts metadata (may break references in parent documentation) |
</details>

The link to the integration documentation page is broken. The meta.json file shows that the developer guide only includes: index, data-modeling, business-logic, security, ai-capabilities, and standards. There is no 'integration' page in the developer section. This link should be either removed or updated to point to an existing page or a different section of the documentation.
```suggestion
**Next:** [Developer Standards →](/docs/developer/standards)
```

The property names in this example don't match the actual PermissionSet schema. According to permission.zod.ts, the correct property names are:
- Use `objects` instead of `objectPermissions`
- Use `fields` instead of `fieldPermissions`  
- The properties `tabVisibility` and `applicationVisibility` don't exist in the PermissionSetSchema

Additionally, the nested properties in `objects` should use:
- `allowCreate`, `allowRead`, `allowEdit`, `allowDelete` (not `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`)
- `viewAllRecords` and `modifyAllRecords` (not `viewAll`, `modifyAll`)

The `fields` property uses `readable` and `editable` (not `read` and `update`).

The SharingRule property names don't match the actual schema. According to sharing.zod.ts, the correct property names are:
- Use `object` instead of `objectName`
- Use `type: 'criteria'` instead of `type: 'criteria_based'`
- The `criteria` property should be `condition` (a formula string, not an object)
- `sharedWith` should have `type` and `value` properties (not direct role array)
- `accessLevel` values should be 'read', 'edit', or 'full' (not 'read_write', 'read_only')

Example of correct structure:
```typescript
{
  name: 'rule_name',
  object: 'account',
  type: 'criteria',
  condition: 'type = "customer" AND is_active = true',
  sharedWith: { type: 'role', value: 'sales_manager' },
  accessLevel: 'edit',
}
```
```suggestion
  object: 'account',
  type: 'criteria',
  
  // Criteria: Which records to share
  condition: 'type = "customer" AND is_active = true',
  
  // Who to share with
  sharedWith: {
    type: 'role',
    value: 'sales_manager',
  },
  
  // Access level granted
  accessLevel: 'edit',
  
  // Also share related records
  includeRelatedObjects: [
    { object: 'contact', accessLevel: 'read' },
    { object: 'opportunity', accessLevel: 'read' },
```

The Agent schema properties in this example don't match the actual AgentSchema from agent.zod.ts. The actual schema doesn't have:
- `description` property (only `name`, `label`, `avatar`, `role`, `instructions`, `model`, `tools`, `knowledge`, `active`, `access`, `tenantId`, `visibility`)
- `label` property exists but not `description`
- `tools` array elements should have `type`, `name`, and optional `description` (the structure shown is correct)
- `knowledge` should have `topics` and `indexes` arrays (not `sources`)
- `triggers` property doesn't exist in the AgentSchema

These examples should be updated to match the actual schema structure, or clarify that this is a conceptual example that may differ from the current implementation.

The document contains mixed Chinese and English text. Line 8 contains Chinese text ("本文档定义了基于ObjectStack协议开发企业管理软件应用市场的最佳方案和编写规范。") while the rest of the document is in English. According to the PR description, "examples/crm 中的文档全部用英文" (all documentation should be in English). This Chinese text should be removed to maintain consistency with the English-only documentation standard.
```suggestion

```

The link to the automation documentation page is broken. The meta.json file shows that the developer guide includes: index, data-modeling, business-logic, security, ai-capabilities, and standards - but there is no 'automation' page. This link should either be removed or updated to point to an existing page (e.g., 'business-logic' which covers automation topics like workflows and triggers).
```suggestion
**Next:** [Business Logic & Automation →](./business-logic)
```
